factsheet.heading: Discover the flavours of Haringey's local eateries
paragraphs:
One Street. Many Cultures. Endless Flavours.
Step off the beaten track and join us for a food adventure along Green Lanes — one of London's most vibrant and multicultural culinary destinations.
Whether you're a visitor, a Londoner after something different, or simply a curious foodie, this tour invites you to explore the flavours, traditions, and stories that have made Green Lanes famous.

Wander through a lively neighbourhood of authentic Turkish, Kurdish, Cypriot, Middle Eastern, Mediterranean, and Balkan eateries — family-run restaurants, cosy cafés, artisan bakeries, traditional sweet shops, and hidden local favourites that have served their communities for generations.

Along the way you'll:
* Taste authentic dishes from around the world
* Meet the local chefs, bakers, and business owners behind them
* Hear the stories behind the food — and the people who make it
* Discover hidden gems loved by locals, not tourists
* Experience the warmth and hospitality that make Green Lanes one of London's best-kept culinary secrets
More than a food tour, this is a cultural journey celebrating the people, traditions, and flavours that bring Haringey to life.
Whether it's your first visit to Green Lanes or a return to a favourite neighbourhood, you'll leave with new tastes, new stories, and memories worth savouring.

factsheet.heading: Golden Key Academy
paragraphs:
The Golden Key Academy is a course training up insightful and engaging guides dedicated to explaining London and bringing its many stories to life. This tour is part of a wider collection of tours created by Golden Key Academy guides for the Open House Festival celebrating their conclusion of the eight month course.
 Further information on the Golden Key Academy can be found here https://open-city.org.uk/golden-key-academy
If you would like to attend this tour, please ensure you have booked a ticket before turning up.
